resources.string: Get lost in the medina, bargain in the souks and end the day with mint tea on a rooftop as the sun sets.
Stand in front of the Pyramids of Giza and imagine how people built them thousands of years ago.
Walk the blue and white streets above the Mediterranean and enjoy a coffee with a view of the bay.
Cross a continent by ferry, visit the Hagia Sophia and taste fresh simit from a street vendor.
Watch the sunset from Oia over white houses, blue domes and the deep blue Aegean Sea.
Explore the Colosseum, toss a coin in the Trevi Fountain and finish with a real Italian gelato.
Marvel at the Sagrada Familia, stroll down Las Ramblas and share tapas with new friends.
Ride the yellow tram through hilly streets and taste a warm pastel de nata fresh from the oven.
Climb the Eiffel Tower, wander along the Seine and enjoy a croissant at a corner cafe.
Take a mountain train to snowy peaks and breathe the cleanest air you have ever felt.
Walk through the Brandenburg Gate and discover a city where history and street art meet.
Cross the old Charles Bridge at sunrise, when the city is quiet and the fog hangs over the river.
Rent a bike and follow the canals past narrow houses, flower markets and cozy cafes.
Sail between steep cliffs and waterfalls on a quiet boat ride through one of the most dramatic landscapes on Earth.
Soak in a geothermal pool and, if you are lucky, watch the northern lights dance across the night sky.
See the city from the top of the Burj Khalifa, then escape to the desert for a dune adventure.
Walk through a narrow canyon until the famous rose-colored Treasury appears right in front of you.
Visit the Taj Mahal at dawn, when the white marble glows soft pink in the early light.
Hike a mountain trail, sleep in a small village and wake up to the highest peaks in the world.
Eat pad thai at a street stall, ride a long-tail boat and visit golden temples glittering in the sun.
Cruise between thousands of limestone islands rising out of calm emerald water.
Walk beneath a tunnel of red gates and sip green tea in a quiet garden that feels centuries old.
Mix old palaces with modern skyscrapers and try spicy street food in a busy night market.
Wander through green rice terraces, visit a peaceful temple and watch the waves from a quiet beach.
See the Opera House from the harbor, then relax on Bondi Beach with the Pacific Ocean in front of you.
Surrounded by mountains and a clear blue lake, this is the adventure capital for every kind of explorer.
Stroll through Central Park, watch the lights of Times Square and see the skyline from a ferry.
Admire turquoise lakes surrounded by snowy mountains and forests in the heart of the Rockies.
Climb the steps of an ancient Mayan pyramid and learn how this civilization studied the stars.
Reach the lost city of the Incas, hidden high in the clouds, and finish your 30-day journey at the top.
